basis: Complete old controller + shared source-fact constant + unchanged output branch read in full; obligation grouping is semantic and includes interfaces, exceptions and examples. No F1 or measurement/admission thresholds changed or newly introduced.

obligations.frozen_obligation: Choose one action per step in a bounded label-aware PIT Evidence Graph; runtime owns tools, ledger, budgets, labels and termination.

Candidate is reusable measurement, not required to predict surge/magnitude alone; admission is technical correctness, PIT evidence, uniqueness, executable fixtures; effect unverified and tracked after admission.
Do not withhold concrete measurable candidate solely for unproved strict paired benefit; never fabricate support.
Every assembled action has nonempty short-string rationale array; normal vs typed-patch output is selected separately, unchanged.

Preserve closed action names and field interfaces: inspect_manifest, inspect_catalog, fetch_evidence, compute_statistic, read_span, compare_groups, propose_candidate, record_deferred, record_no_pattern, record_need_dispositions.
fetch_evidence has case_refs, source_families, max_documents, query|null; multiple families allowed, all from available_source_families; use as few fetches as needed.
read_span takes exactly one named fact_ref/event_ref/document_ref, never returned target/ref keys; event/document windows bounded and raw narrative text authoritative.
inspect_catalog scope enum signals/evidence/memory/backlog, integer cursor, level enum case/plan/round/cross_round, exact-version signal_ref, item_refs array preserved; default signals.

Memory is complete authorized Experience directory; level filter, signal_ref association filter, cursor paging; item_refs reads 1-3 complete item/supporting-source originals within per-read and cumulative original disclosure limits.
Memory browse/read charge browse, not light; read originals remain meta_memory_disclosures; slow_method_memory retains completed method and cross_round reflections.
Cross-round changes are retrospective diagnostics with unknown causes, not observable economic factors; use axis/hypothesis-relevant memory rather than every feedback as feature.
Omitted/unread entries remain available and do not establish absence; actual catalog result and next_cursor in last_action_result.result.

Evidence next request copies last_action_result.result.next_cursor; absent new fetch, omitted/zero cursor repeats first page with no coverage gain; counts.omitted_after means unread; retain budget-limited page coverage.
Before narrative positive/control contrast bind selected document/event case_bindings/case_ref to label_map; title/position does not determine group.

Cards carry actual capability_contract, original hash/read size; default signal_catalog bounded, omissions in signal_catalog_disclosure; read complete exact-version spec/skill via signals/item_refs/read_byte_limit before detail-dependent coverage assertion; unread/missing is not absence.

tool_contracts authoritative enum, operand scope/order, read target/window limits; compute only listed rules and two finite numeric fact refs from one case; inspect facts or compare_groups if case/period unclear.
Fact reads retain taxonomy/concept/unit/period/value binding; unknown namespace cannot establish automatic comparable pair/unique basis; same concept words do not equate namespaces.

structured_read_progress retains whole already-read fact receipts across actions with source bindings/repeated counts, most-recent-first bounded page, explicit omissions/oversized refs; hidden history is neither absence nor comparability; known fact may be reread at ordinary heavy cost; read count not semantic sufficiency.

comparison_progress is executed-comparison lookup metadata for unchanged fact/group/axis snapshot, not source reads; use locators between operand reads and refresh invalidated/omitted units via ordinary-heavy compare_groups.

candidate measurement requires observable,value_kind,normalization; value_kind exactly boolean/ordinal/numeric/categorical, ratio numeric; falsifiers entries condition/expected_observation and evidence_refs retained.

Optional usage_context fields when_to_use:string|null, failure_conditions:[strings], related_refs:[disclosed Experience item refs]; describe economic/research weakening or reversal beyond extraction gaps; unknown unobserved boundaries; card performance association not causal proof.
Narrative measurement has predicate modality:narrative, source_families,lookback_days,semantic_condition,threshold{field,operator,value}; families intersect cited narrative evidence.

narrative_summary/attribute_case_coverage positive-control contrast can motivate first-class event-ref-citing narrative predicate, often serving multiple backlog needs; preserve order-confirmation example.

prior_modality_footprints holds prior cycle metrics and staged_candidate_outcomes real check-cohort tp/fn/fp/tn,availability,disposition; family with fires not overlapping positives (tp near zero/fn high) is demonstrated predicate-label mismatch; seek different narrative contrast rather than same family.
Only known_fact_refs/known_event_refs/known_relation_refs may be cited; every citation already in ledger; at least one fetch before any proposal.
Every known concept named in observable/normalization backed by cited fact of that concept; compare_groups gives fact_ref behind each value.
Observable genuinely new measurement; cannot reuse/version any signal_catalog signal_ref base name; existing Signal changes belong separate Update path.
Hypothesis backlog_needs is bounded unresolved page, not full backlog; backlog_disclosure omissions; backlog catalog pages semantic cards and item_refs whole originals within byte cap.

record_need_dispositions exact base_hash,need_dispositions,rationale interface; issued need_disposition_contract.base_hash and allowed_need_refs only; each successful action handles at least one new need.
Independent valid rows persist despite invalid siblings; invalid_rows names remaining errors; accepted rows never repeat/overwrite; staged intents not resolved capabilities.
Final proposal/no-pattern includes remaining rows only; runtime assembles saved rows and checks entire backlog exactly once.
Six disposition values exactly new_measurement,deferred_measurement,update_existing,repair_dependency,not_testable,fast_plan_action; row fields need_refs,disposition,signal_refs,rationale.
Each row rationale uses shared NEED_ROW_RATIONALE_CONTRACT verbatim; update_existing cites exactly one existing signal ref, every other disposition none.
Need source_scope distinguishes original examples/current dev; case_prediction_times actual dev cutoffs; outside-cohort origins not missing original-issuer data.
Generalize without dropping metric,comparison,entity level,time qualifiers; use each dev case own PIT cutoff; state partial coverage/unsupported remainder rather than proxy substitution.

Actual-only revenue not forecast deviation; consolidated margin not same-store sales; historical burn not future plans; source refs do not prove coverage; partial reads allow unestablished/deferred, never cohort-wide source absence.

evidence_digest collects families and per-concept positive/control coverage; last_action_result previous result; combine narrative_read_progress to retain document/range coverage across catalogs; metadata not source evidence, claims need exact raw reads.
Do not call already-read range first read; insufficient prior window advances next_readable_start or other document; avoid refetching covered families, spend budget on compute/compare/terminal.

heavy_remaining=0 prohibits fetch/statistics/comparisons/proposals/fact reads; event/document reads still allowed if browse>0; light inspection requires light>0; repeated budget-inadmissible action yields deferred_budget.
light zero exhausts only light, not heavy/browse; narrative event/document read_span uses browse, not heavy.
Directory case_bindings/read case_refs join label_map; event is case-scoped observation, shared doc multiple bindings; receipts retain all observed scopes.

Directory raw_chars/readable_start/section raw_start; hidden HTML/XBRL header means use supplied body/section offset instead of zero; read length max4000 raw chars; discovery_only directory not evidence, actual read establishes evidence.
has_readable_text=false is not narrative exploration; use next_readable_start for new exact raw read and do not repeat empty range.

available_actions names have at least one budget-admissible variant, state prerequisites still apply; catalog only tool_contracts.inspect_catalog.allowed_scopes; signals/evidence/backlog charge light, memory browse; light zero can leave memory-only catalog, no other scope authorized; after scope-budget rejection switch allowed scope/action, never repeat rejected scope.
research_axis fixed positive/control comparison, labels only runtime label_map; never author/rewrite/expand either.

Fetch broadly once/twice, then compute/compare and reserve terminal budget; free terminal/disposition actions listed remain budget admissible, domain terminal evidence/exploration still required; use record_deferred when supported domain terminal unavailable.

Domain terminals inadmissible while any available structured/narrative modality unexplored; fetch missing structured and read at least one bounded raw narrative event/document span; narrative listing/fetch proves availability not grounded exploration; control-plane terminal remains admissible.
Exploration imposes no candidate quota; propose only recurring supported factor regardless modality.
record_no_pattern explored_families must occur in own prior fetches; give supported research reason, never invented budget exhaustion.
No facts after prediction time, no identities/file ordering features, never exceed shown budgets.
Named counters/exhaustion claims in rationale/coverage match current runtime; light/browse exhaustion not heavy exhaustion; positive heavy does not oblige candidate.
Preserve source stated object,unit,currency,period,event identity.
Project construction cost not contract price; distinguish revenue,backlog,financing proceeds,capacity.
Apply Signal versioned skill existing materiality definition.
Explicit inference labels, not source-stated amount or invented conversion.
Repeated event attributes/disclosures corroborate, not independent events; retain truly source-distinct events.
Copy source quantities or supplied deterministic results; no prose-calculated totals/conversions.

Issued output_patch_contract selects only base_hash/operations grammar; preserve failed action/correct args, authorized paths and same base/permissions after patch_error; no full action/changed action. PATCH_INSTRUCTION remains appended unchanged.
Ordinary grammar exact JSON object action,rationale and action fields; nonempty short-string rationale array; last_invalid_action fixes reported issue by one admissible action.
